conflicts.note: The manufacturer publishes two figures: the Manufacturer Direct (see-through) price of $247,900 and a window-sticker MSRP of $346,900. The direct price was also cross-checked against a dealer listing (Yozzy Overland, Post Falls ID) at exactly $247,900. A manufacturer-hosted rebate-program window sticker shows $223,110 after a $24,790 rebate; that is a program price applied to individual units, not standing pricing, and this site does not display it as the price. Re-verified Oct 16, 2026: the $247,900 direct price is confirmed on both the dedicated Aegis model page (published product price) and the comparison page; the sticker figure stands as logged.
conflicts.resolution: Display uses the manufacturer's published direct price, with the sticker MSRP disclosed in the price note.

conflicts.note: Dealer listing metadata says 2 or 3 on various models; the manufacturer rates every model 'seats and sleeps 4' (queen bed plus the Vanhalla swing-seat bed, which on the Aegis suits two smaller children, or one adult combined with a swivel seat). Manufacturer figure stands. Comparison page re-checked Oct 16, 2026: still 'Seats & Sleeps 4' across the line.

name: Aegis Series
notes: Flagship model. Recirculating Cyber Shower standard (manufacturer claims 10+ minute showers on under 3.5 gallons). Remote Vans publishes battery capacity in kWh at 51V only; amp-hours are never stated. No suspension lift height or approach/departure angles are published for any model. Ledger restructured to the model-page template keys on Oct 16, 2026 (freshWaterCapacity -> freshWaterGal, grayWaterCapacity -> grayWaterGal, batteryCapacity -> battery, conversionWarranty -> warranty) and re-verified against the dedicated Aegis model page (remotevans.com/van/aegis-series-2026/) and the comparison page: chassis confirmed as Sprinter 2500 by the manufacturer on the model page (previously hedged as dealer-sourced), ground clearance upgraded from not-published to a manufacturer figure, and exterior length, interior height, fuel capacity, GVWR and the winter equipment record added from the model page. The live Remote Vans review article was cross-checked the same day and agrees with this ledger on price, water, battery and warranty; no disagreement found.
